origins.section: CP-SAT Runs a Portfolio of Subsolvers, One per Worker
A Search Strategy Decides Which Variable to Fix Next and to Which Value
LNS Frees Part of a Good Plan and Lets CP-SAT Rebuild It

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-workers: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-workers: "CP-SAT does not split anything: it runs a portfolio, a set of different subsolvers... all working on the whole model at once and sharing what they find."
recorded.prompt:q-strategy: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-strategy: "add_decision_strategy alone changes nothing on one worker. The last line is the same as the first... FIXED_SEARCH is what makes the solver follow it."
recorded.prompt:q-lns: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-lns: "Fix the rest: every variable outside the neighborhood keeps its value in the current plan, with a constraint x = x̄".

recorded.prompt:q-workers:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-workers:a: "A MIP solver... usually splits one search tree between its threads. CP-SAT does not split anything".
recorded.prompt:q-workers:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-workers:b: "a set of different subsolvers (complete searches with different settings, plus heuristics)". They are not repeats.
recorded.prompt:q-workers:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-workers:d: "each better bound any of them proves becomes everyone's bound". More workers add "the ones that raise the bound".
recorded.prompt:q-strategy:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-strategy:a: AUTOMATIC_SEARCH + NPV order's first plan is $208,873k, the same as the default. "under AUTOMATIC_SEARCH this run did not follow the order."
recorded.prompt:q-strategy:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-strategy:b: "The last line is the same as the first, number for number". The bound is the same $224,293k.
recorded.prompt:q-strategy:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-strategy:c: The one-worker run with the order ran and gave results: "AUTOMATIC_SEARCH + NPV order first $208,873k...".
recorded.prompt:q-lns:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lns:b: "Fix the rest... keeps its value in the current plan, with a constraint". They are fixed, not deleted.
recorded.prompt:q-lns:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lns:c: Variables outside the neighborhood are fixed by a constraint ("model.add(var == value)"); the hint only says where to start.
recorded.prompt:q-lns:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lns:d: "Fixing variables to constants is what makes the sub-model small". They are fixed, not relaxed.
